title: 基礎堆疊操作
question:
堆疊（stack）是「後進先出」：就像疊盤子，最後放上去的盤子要最先拿下來。
請用 stack 存整數，支援三種指令：
1 x：把 x 放到頂端（push）
2：拿掉頂端的數字（pop）；如果是空的，輸出 Empty!
3：輸出頂端的數字（top）；如果是空的，輸出 Empty!
第一行輸入 N，接下來輸入 N 個指令。每個要輸出的結果各輸出一行。

test_case.note: 拿掉 20 之後頂端是 10；10 也拿掉之後，pop 和 top 都是空的

en.title: Basic Stack Operations
en.question:
A stack is "last in, first out", like a pile of plates: the last plate on top comes off first.
Use a stack of whole numbers with three commands:
1 x: put x on the top (push)
2: remove the top number (pop). If it is empty, output Empty!
3: output the top number (top). If it is empty, output Empty!
First input N, then N commands. Output each result on its own line.

test_case.note: After popping 20 the top is 10. After popping 10, pop and top find it empty
